# Code Map — Backend

One shared .NET API: one class library per domain, composed in the Api gateway. Every
domain library has the same shape — Domain/ (aggregates), Application/ (vertical use-case
slices), Infrastructure/ (DI root, Endpoints/, Persistence/).

**Migrations: DO NOT READ files under Infrastructure/Persistence/Migrations/ — generated 1,600–2,000-line Designer files. The map records count + latest name only.**

## Api gateway — Backend/src/Api/NorthernLink.Api (7 files)
<!-- gen:api:start -->
Composition root: Program.cs — DI + endpoint registration for every domain library.
Files: Auth/AuthorizationPolicyRegistration.cs, HostDefaults/HostDefaultsExtensions.cs, NorthernLink.Api.csproj, Program.cs, Tenancy/JwtTenantContext.cs, appsettings.Development.json, appsettings.json
<!-- gen:api:end -->
<!-- notes:api:start -->
- Program.cs is where a new domain library gets wired: Add\<Domain\>(...) + Map\<Domain\>Endpoints(). Auth policies register in Auth/AuthorizationPolicyRegistration.cs.
<!-- notes:api:end -->

## Shared kernel — Backend/src/Shared (70 files)
<!-- gen:shared:start -->
Kernel/: AggregateRoot, AuthorizationPolicies, Entity, Error, IDomainEvent, ITenantScoped, PageInfo, RequiredEnvironmentVariable, Result, Roles, SeedTenant, TenantType
Messaging/: ICommand, IQuery, ISender, Sender
EventBus/: BusPublicationRegistry, EventRoutingKey, IOutboxTransport, IntegrationEventSubscriptions, OutboxPollingConsumer, OutboxPollingOptions, OutboxPollingServiceCollectionExtensions, RabbitMqInitializer, RabbitMqIntegrationEventBus, RabbitMqIntegrationEventConsumer, RabbitMqOptions
IntegrationEvents/ (the only cross-domain contract surface): Billing (1), Clients (2), Drivers (1), Fleet (4), Trips (4)
Events/ (4): flat
Persistence/ (20): Auditing/, Projections/
Storage/ (2): flat
Tenancy/ (3): flat
<!-- gen:shared:end -->
<!-- notes:shared:start -->
- Kernel/Roles.cs is the only source of role strings (case-sensitive, ordinal matching) — never string literals.
- Messaging/Sender.cs is the hand-rolled mediator (no MediatR). EventBus: delivery is outbox polling (OutboxPollingConsumer); RabbitMQ is wired but dormant — BusPublicationRegistry is empty.
<!-- notes:shared:end -->
